item.description: Friday, September 18, 2026 UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT Description automatically generated DISTRICT OF MAINE **PRESS RELEASE** NATURALIZATION CEREMONY CELEBRATED September 18, 2026 On September 18, 2026, U.S. District Judge Stacey D. Neumann commemorated Citizenship and Constitution Day with a special ceremony at the University of Southern Maine in Portland. The Honorable Stacey D. Neumann presided and administered the oath of citizenship to forty-one new citizens from twenty-five different countries, including Angola, Bangladesh, Brazil, Burundi, Cambodia, Canada, Central African Republic, China, Columbia, Democratic Republic of Congo, Costa Rica, Djibouti, France, Greece, Hungary, India, Iraq, Kazakhstan, South Korea, Lithuania, Rwanda, South Sudan, Spain, the United Kingdom, and Vietnam. item.content:encoded:
Friday, September 18, 2026

UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT

Description automatically generated

DISTRICT OF MAINE

**PRESS RELEASE**

NATURALIZATION CEREMONY CELEBRATED

September 18, 2026

 

On September 18, 2026, U.S. District Judge Stacey D. Neumann commemorated Citizenship and Constitution Day with a special ceremony at the University of Southern Maine in Portland.

The Honorable Stacey D. Neumann presided and administered the oath of citizenship to forty-one new citizens from twenty-five different countries, including Angola, Bangladesh, Brazil, Burundi, Cambodia, Canada, Central African Republic, China, Columbia, Democratic Republic of Congo, Costa Rica, Djibouti, France, Greece, Hungary, India, Iraq, Kazakhstan, South Korea, Lithuania, Rwanda, South Sudan, Spain, the United Kingdom, and Vietnam.

A copy of Judge Neumann’s remarks are posted on the Court’s website.

item.description: HRSA is publishing this notice of petitions received under the National Vaccine Injury Compensation Program (the Program), as required by the Public Health Service (PHS) Act, as amended. item.content:encoded:
Wednesday, September 23, 2026

The Clerk’s Office for the U.S. District Court for the District of Maine will be closed on September 29, 2026, for a full-day staff training. 

Designated staff will be available to address urgent matters and will monitor the Joint ECF Inbox throughout the day.
